spec.name: Grammar sampler A/B/C — model and toolchain probe
spec.description: Prerequisite check only. No timing, inference or benchmark metrics. Verify the JY job account can read the registered Qwen model and build native Metal code.

runtime.command:
set -eu
cd mesh
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 2c82637ba4499b421b7703f6efeb80c0b90098d1
test -r "$MODEL_DIR/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf"
mkdir -p "$JIANYANG_ARTIFACT_DIR"
{ git rev-parse HEAD; sw_vers; sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string hw.memsize; clang++ --version; cmake --version; ninja --version; just --version; xcrun --find metal; stat -f '%z' "$MODEL_DIR/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf"; shasum -a 256 "$MODEL_DIR/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf"; } > "$JIANYANG_ARTIFACT_DIR/probe.txt"
cat "$JIANYANG_ARTIFACT_DIR/probe.txt"
